publication_rules: Never infer a state or UT complaint route from a central portal.
A portal link alone does not verify that a complaint can be filed there or establish its legal effect.
For every legal proposition, record the exact official instrument or service page, issuing authority, section or service, publication/effective date, amendment status and date checked.
Keep Central, State and Union Territory jurisdiction explicit; some subjects may involve concurrent or overlapping authorities.
Do not label a jurisdiction as complete until primary-source checks and qualified Indian legal-professional review are recorded.
Use fictional data only in prototype tests; do not collect real FIRs, identity documents or private case papers.
rollout_order: Qualified legal review before any public legal-answer release
source_notes: NALSA official homepage's 'Websites of State Legal Services Authorities' directory was checked on 28 November 2026 for SLSA portal links: https://nalsa.gov.in/. The directory has some legacy UT entries; merged-territory mapping requires separate verification.

Supreme Court of India jurisdiction page, Annexure A, was checked 28 November 2026 for territorial jurisdiction and principal seats/benches: https://www.sci.gov.in/jurisdiction/. This records the competent High Court name only; it does not verify each court's exact URL, filing process or a case's venue.
